purpose: Teach: 貸し出し/同種/同業/各県/各党/引き継が/積み立て/役立て

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 機材貸し出し制度、若い頃に整備したな。
lines.en: I set up an equipment-loan system way back when I was younger.
lines.style: Reflective, unhurried. Slight smile in the voice — memory settling in. Measured cadence with a pause before the turn-back to youth. Warm, not sentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。同種の業務、効率化を進めています。
lines.en: Yes. We're working to streamline similar operations right now.
lines.style: Respectful but measured. Not defensive — factual, grounded. Eyes forward. A slight lean into the practical. Shows deference through clear articulation, not obsequiousness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 同業の動向、地に足を付けて見ろ。
lines.en: Keep your eyes on what the competition's doing. Stay practical about it.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Weight on 'keep your eyes' — a light instruction, not a warning. Slow, deliberate. The tone of someone who has seen short-sightedness cost people.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 各県の支店長、年に一度、東京で集めています。
lines.en: Each year we bring the branch heads from every prefecture to Tokyo for a gathering.
lines.style: Direct, steady. Pride without showing it — this is a system he's built. Clear enunciation. Even pacing. The confidence of someone who knows exactly what he's doing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 各党の政策、業界に大きく影響する。
lines.en: Policy shifts from the government — they move the needle for the whole industry.
lines.style: Quiet weight. Not lecturing — sharing hard-won knowledge. Slight exhale before the second half, like he's seen this play out. Grounded, not alarmist.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。経営、引き継がれてから、勉強の毎日です。
lines.en: Yes. Since taking over management, it's been constant study.
lines.style: Humble, but with quiet conviction underneath. Not self-pitying — stating fact. Measured pace. A touch of strain at the edges, but held steady. Respect carried through posture in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 積み立て型の信託、長期で大切だ。
lines.en: Long-term trust funds like that — they're what matter over time.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate. Weight on 'matter over time' — this is accrued wisdom speaking. Patient. The tone of someone who learned this the hard way and is passing it forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。先輩の知恵、役立てさせてください。
lines.en: Yes. Please let me put your experience to work for us.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Respectful without flatness. A bridge being crossed — asking permission to learn. Steady eye contact in the voice. Slight softening on the close.
